designated_cross_farm_checkpoint.reason: Farm A/B were re-exported using the strict 10-feature physical schema; power_residual is excluded on purpose because it requires target-domain calibration that would break zero-shot validity. This is the best-by-validation 10-feature-only configuration.
designated_cross_farm_checkpoint.note: No Farm A/B evaluation results for this checkpoint exist in the repository yet. Do NOT reuse the results below as if they were produced by this checkpoint; rerun the external evaluation commands in cross_farm_results.md to populate real numbers here.

superseded_results.why_superseded: This checkpoint used an 11-feature configuration (power_residual included) that is incompatible with the strict 10-feature Farm A/B exports. It is NOT the designated cross-farm checkpoint.

threshold_selection.method: maximum F1 on Farm C validation split

preprocessing.scaler: frozen Farm C scaler, reused unchanged on Farm A/B

notes: Farm A and Farm B are external test-only zero-shot evaluations; no retraining occurred on either farm.
No threshold tuning was performed on Farm A or Farm B; any evaluation must reuse the threshold frozen from Farm C validation.
The 'superseded_results' above were produced with the wrong checkpoint (farm_c_final, 11-feature) and must not be cited as the project's designated cross-farm result.
The designated checkpoint (farm_c_lr5e4, 10-feature) has not yet been evaluated on Farm A/B in this repository; rerun is required before reporting final cross-farm numbers.
